title: Ahyeon: The Voice of BABYMONSTER (v2 — entity-anchored)
logline: When YG needed a new voice seven years after BLACKPINK, a trainee named Ahyeon became the centerpiece of BABYMONSTER.

scenes.label: hook
scenes.narration: Seven years after BLACKPINK, YG Entertainment was ready to introduce its first new girl group since them.

visual.note: screen must show BLACKPINK the moment the word is spoken
then pivot to the new-group reveal film

scenes.label: body
scenes.narration: At the center of it: a trainee named Ahyeon — the voice YG chose to lead BABYMONSTER.

scenes.label: body
scenes.narration: On January 15, 2023, YG introduced her to the world — main vocalist, lead rapper, and lead dancer.

scenes.label: body
scenes.narration: But when the group finally debuted, Ahyeon was not there — BABYMONSTER stepped on stage as six.

visual.note: BATTER UP era — the debut as six

scenes.label: body
scenes.narration: Fans waited — then YG announced her return, and BABYMONSTER was seven again.

visual.note: BABYMONS7ER visual film — the return-era reveal

scenes.label: body
scenes.narration: On April 1, 2024, all seven members finally debuted together with SHEESH.

visual.note: all members on screen when 'seven members' is spoken

scenes.label: body
scenes.narration: Ahyeon's vocals carried the chorus — and the world started to listen.

scenes.label: body
scenes.narration: On THE FIRST TAKE, one uninterrupted live vocal settled every doubt about her voice.

visual.note: SHEESH THE FIRST TAKE at Ahyeon's vocal showcase (~t120)

scenes.label: body
scenes.narration: From a fifteen-year-old trainee to the centerpiece of a global stage —

scenes.label: outro
scenes.narration: this is Ahyeon — the voice of BABYMONSTER.
